cs.t: I'm literally using a 2.5Gbps RTL8156(B?) without adding any drivers on an M1 MBA as I type this, and I've never had  any  stability issues with it. I also have an RTL8153 that works flawlessly too. I transfer tons of large videos and RAW photos imported from my mirrorless camera over these network adapters to a NAS. I've been using these for quite a few months. I'm not stuck on 100Mbps adapters, but maybe you are. Usermode vs kernelmode seems irrelevant... if anything, I want the benefits of usermode isolation for  more  things. Monolithic kernels aren't great for security.
cs.th: AirPlay and Touch Bar = Network Disaster
